skill.summary: Conduct a comprehensive AI readiness audit scoring 8 dimensions, identifying gaps, and delivering a prioritized 90-day actionable plan with budget estimates.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI Readiness Assessment skill.
- Enables structured audits across 8 readiness dimensions, each with detailed scoring criteria and weights.
- Produces a prioritized 90-day action plan, complete with budget ranges and ROI benchmarks by company size.
- Includes industry benchmarks and common assessment mistakes.
- Provides actionable templates, scoring guidelines, and links to supporting resources.
